title: 86% of Gym and Studio Owners Grew Membership This Year, Even as Costs and Competition Rise  - Health & Fitness Association

facts.fact: Wellhub's Fitness Business Growth Report 2026 found that 86% of gym and studio owners grew their membership base in the year surveyed.
facts.quote: finds that 86% of gym and studio owners grew their membership base this year and 56% improved their profit margin

facts.fact: The Wellhub-commissioned survey covered 662 gym and studio owners across 11 countries, fielded through an independent research firm.
facts.quote: The report surveyed 662 gym and studio owners across 11 countries through an independent research firm.

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 40% of owners said revenue is growing faster than costs.
facts.quote: Forty percent say revenue is currently growing faster than costs, 23% say the two are keeping pace, and 37% say costs are growing faster.

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 95% of owners said competition has intensified over the past three years.
facts.quote: with 95% of owners saying it has intensified over the past three years

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 40% of owners planned to open new locations in the next 12 months.
facts.quote: 40% plan to open new locations in the next 12 months

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 86% of owners said members have become more price-sensitive this year.
facts.quote: Eighty-six percent of owners say members have become more price-sensitive this year

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, the most common member request was more flexible or shorter contracts (66%), while lower prices ranked fourth at 46%.
facts.quote: More flexible or shorter contracts are the most common request (66%), followed by better digital or hybrid options (65%) and recovery services (48%). Lower prices rank only fourth, at 46%.

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 82% of owners said their customer acquisition costs increased this year.
facts.quote: Eighty-two percent of owners say their customer acquisition costs have increased this year.

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, only 6% of owners were supported by a dedicated marketing team or agency.
facts.quote: With only 6% supported by a dedicated marketing team or agency

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 87% of owners spend up to half of their working week personally handling marketing and member acquisition.
facts.quote: 87% spend up to half of their working week personally handling marketing and member acquisition activities.

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 65% of owners invested in new technology such as CRM platforms, booking systems, automation and AI tools in the past year.
facts.quote: Sixty-five percent of owners have invested in new technology (including CRM platforms, booking systems, automation and AI tools) in the past year

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 52% of owners said AI will be essential to competing for members over the next 12 months.
facts.quote: 52% say AI will be essential to competing for members over the next 12 months.

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 85% of owners said at least a quarter of their facility sits unused during off-peak hours.
facts.quote: Eighty-five percent of owners say at least a quarter of their facility sits unused during off-peak hours

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, only 20% of owners had a developed strategy to monetize unused off-peak capacity.
facts.quote: yet only 20% have a developed strategy to monetize that capacity

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 76% of owners partnered with a corporate wellness platform said the channel's revenue is new income rather than shifted from existing members.
facts.quote: Among owners partnered with a corporate wellness platform, 76% say the revenue generated through the channel represents new income

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 96% of Wellhub partners grew membership this year, compared with 80% of operators without a corporate wellness partnership.
facts.quote: Ninety-six percent of Wellhub partners grew membership this year, compared with 80% of operators without a corporate wellness partnership.

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 30% of non-partner operators said more than half their facility sits unused off-peak, versus 5% of Wellhub partners.
facts.quote: while 30% of operators without a corporate wellness partnership say more than half of their facility sits unused during off-peak hours, that figure is just 5% among Wellhub partners.

facts.fact: Wellhub's own data shows 90% of Wellhub members visiting partner gyms are reactivated or new to those facilities.
facts.quote: 90% of Wellhub members visiting partner gyms are reactivated or new to those facilities.

facts.fact: HFA benchmarking research cited in the release found high-profit clubs offer corporate programming at 38% globally versus 30% for operators overall.
facts.quote: high-profit clubs are more likely to offer corporate programming than operators overall: 38% versus 30% globally

facts.fact: HFA benchmarking research cited in the release found high-profit clubs offer corporate programming at 48% in the US versus 35% for operators overall.
facts.quote: and 48% versus 35% in the US

facts.fact: Of the 662 survey respondents, 265 (40%) were current Wellhub partners and 397 (60%) were not.
facts.quote: Of the 662 respondents, 265 (40%) are current Wellhub partners and 397 (60%) are not.

facts.fact: The Wellhub survey was fielded between March 30 and April 9, 2026.
facts.quote: conducted by an independent research firm between March 30 and April 9, 2026

facts.fact: Wellhub states that over 50,000 companies in 18 countries use its platform and that its employees get access to over 110,000 gyms, studios and wellness apps.
facts.quote: Over 50,000 companies in 18 countries use Wellhub.
